goal.objective: Permit bounded live StegFin Inventory-N and pretrade preparation on any authorized StegVerse continuity carrier without making resident sovereign-heartbeat activation a prerequisite, while preserving TV/TVC-only credential authority and USER_ONLY signing/broadcast.
success_predicates: A collision-safe continuity claim exists before execution
No resident STEGFIN-LIVE-ENTRY-003 or STEGFIN-LIVE-PRETRADE-005 claim owns the same validation lineage
Fresh complete Inventory N is observed credential-free
Provider operation is executed only by TV/TVC/vault through local Unix or HTTPS broker transport
No non-TV/TVC secret or token is accepted by the carrier
The exact repository-owned 12.50 USDC to WETH request is consumed unchanged
Execution stops at WALLET_HANDOFF_READY with signed=false and broadcast=false
failure_predicates: A continuity run starts while an equivalent resident/federated trade claim is active
A carrier invents its own claim or fence
A GitHub token, provider API key, wallet key, bearer token or other consumer credential is accepted
Provider secret material crosses the TV/TVC/vault boundary
The fallback signs, broadcasts or claims settlement

authority.authority_source: StegVerse-Labs/stegfin-governance validation mandate + TV/TVC route/lease/vault authority + USER_ONLY wallet authority

blocker.problem_statement: The current claim issuer treats missing heartbeat state as an empty state and does not explicitly serialize concurrent claim acquisition. That is insufficient evidence for a collision-safe live trade lineage.
blocker.machine_observable_release_condition: Deterministic validation proves claim acquisition fails closed when authoritative heartbeat/worker-coordination evidence is absent and proves concurrent acquisition cannot mint two active claims for the same collision scope.
blocker.next_solution_action: Harden and validate the claim issuer without adding GitHub-token, provider-token, wallet-key, bearer-token, cloud-secret or non-TV/TVC credential inputs.

completion.next_authorized_action: Resolve the claim-issuer fail-closed validation blocker. Only after that blocker is released may the machine scheduler admit process:stegfin-continuity-carrier-v1.
completion.release_condition: Claim-issuer fail-closed validation passes, then WALLET_HANDOFF_READY or fail-closed worker receipt; yield immediately if resident STEGFIN-LIVE-ENTRY-003 or STEGFIN-LIVE-PRETRADE-005 owns the validation lineage
